strategies.name: Detect Excessive or Unauthorized Bandwidth Usage for Botnet, Proxyjacking, or Scanning Purposes

analytics.name: Analytic 0080
analytics.guidance: Processes invoking network-intensive child processes or uploading large data volumes, often from non-standard user or system contexts, with evidence of long-duration TCP/UDP sessions to unusual destinations.

tuning.description: Bandwidth anomalies should be assessed over 5-15 min or hourly windows depending on environment size.
Some organizations whitelist traffic to countries based on geolocation.
Legitimate processes using high bandwidth (e.g., backup tools) must be excluded.

analytics.name: Analytic 0081
analytics.guidance: User-initiated processes generating sustained outbound traffic over common or non-standard ports, often outside business hours, potentially linked to scanning or proxyjacking. Includes curl, wget, masscan, or proxy clients.

tuning.description: Can be tuned for specific bandwidth abuse tools (e.g., proxychains, 3proxy).
Baseline deviation thresholds must be environment-specific.

log_sources.name: auditd:SYSCALL
log_sources.channel: execve calls with high-frequency or known bandwidth-intensive tools

log_sources.name: NSM:Flow
log_sources.channel: large outbound data flows or long-duration connections

analytics.name: Analytic 0082
analytics.guidance: Suspicious long-lived or high-throughput connections by non-Apple signed apps or processes not commonly associated with network uploads. Detect background processes using open sockets for data egress.

tuning.description: Non-signed or non-Apple signed binaries can raise confidence levels.
Observed data rate per process over time (e.g., MB/s).

log_sources.name: macos:unifiedlog
log_sources.channel: process + network metrics correlation for bandwidth saturation

log_sources.name: macos:unifiedlog
log_sources.channel: exec or spawn calls to proxy tools or torrent clients

analytics.name: Analytic 0083
analytics.guidance: Containerized apps or sidecar containers generating excessive outbound traffic or being leveraged for proxy networks. Includes sudden increases in network interface stats, especially in dormant or low-util apps.

tuning.description: Baseline per container must be defined by app purpose and normal traffic.
Certain image names or registries may be prone to abuse (e.g., public image hosting mining or proxyware).

log_sources.name: containers:osquery
log_sources.channel: bandwidth-intensive command execution from within a container namespace

analytics.name: Analytic 0084
analytics.guidance: Virtual instances or workloads generating sustained outbound data rates, often to TOR, VPN, or proxy endpoints. Often coincides with unusual IAM usage or deployed scripts (e.g., cron jobs using proxy clients).

tuning.description: High-throughput instance types are more likely to be targeted for hijacking.
Customize detection thresholds based on cloud provider quotas or billing alerts.

log_sources.name: AWS:VPCFlowLogs
log_sources.channel: egress > 90th percentile or frequent connection reuse
